dialogue.n10_high_court.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n10_high_court.role: Moeteledipele wa Bosupi ba Khomishene • DPCI Hawks
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p1: "Amogela kwa Khomisheneng ya Dipatlisiso, Sbu. Berth 14 e senotse sephiri sa boemakepe, jaanong setlhopha sa botlōlō se re lwantsha ka babueledi ba ba apereng seeta le ditaelo tsa sephiri tsa State Security."
dialogue.n10_high_court.root.p2: "Se se botlhoko le go feta, re thibetse dipalopalo tsa tsela ya sefofane go tswa King Shaka International. Sefofane ZS-900—Gulfstream ya motho ka boena—e tshetswe leokwane kwa Hangar 7 go ntsha Zuko, Ma-Sibi, le Mokoena go ya Dubai."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_act2_briefin: "Dipontsho tse pedi tse dikgolo: Sa ntlha, Sovereign Pearl Offshore Trust Deed go tswa kwa Ridge Penthouses e e supang gore bobedi jwa bone ba na le seabe mo setlhopheng. Sa bobedi, Midlands Super-Lab Batch Telemetry go tswa kwa ditankeng tsa metsi tsa kwa bokone."
"Bula nngwe ya diphitlhelelo tse go senola Citrus Estate le King Shaka Hangar 7—kgotsa sireletsa tsotlhe fa o batla go ba tsenya mo diketane botlhe mo tseleng ya difofane."
dialogue.n10_high_court.vdm_dockets_moti: "Tshupiso ya molao e e gakgamatsang, Sbu. Seo se bofa diatla tsa babueledi ba ga Ma-Sibi ba ba sa ikanyegeng ka diura tse dingwe tse masome-manè le borobedi, mme se pateletsa mokwaledi wa Ridge go bula buka ya DIFC."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p1: "O latetse ditanka tsa metsi go ya kwa godimo ga thaba, Sbu. Go a kgatlha. Bontsi jwa banna ba ema fa ba fitlha kwa matlong a kwa lebopong kwa Umhlanga."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.root.p2: "Lebelela mo Packhouse B. Namune tsa Valencia mo godimo, crystal e e phepa ya diperesente tse masome-robong-bongwe mo dikrateng tse di maaka kafa tlase, e ya tlhamalala kwa King Shaka Cargo Apron. Mme o eme mo gare ga thobo ya me."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_man: "Ke boifa? Nnyaa, Sbu—ke go rulaganya sesha. Khomishene ya Dipatlisiso e tlhoka selo se se gakgamatsang, ka jalo Ma-Sibi le Mokoena ba a tshoga. Fa gare ga moo, mafaratlhatlha a re a agileng fano a dira dimilione tse masome-pedi tsa Euro ka kgwedi."

"Fa o fitlha kwa Hangar 7 bosigo jono, o tla nna le kgetho: re tshwarele naga e e tla re emisetsang ka Labobedi, fisa polase ka setlhopha sa ga Bra Bheki, kgotsa o tseye dikotlolo tsa bogosi ka wena."
dialogue.n11_citrus_estate.zuko_act2_tru: "Batho ba ba thunyang ba Gauteng ba a ikgogela morago. O iponetse setulo mo tafoleng, Sbu. Tsaa se go tswa mo polokelong ya packhouse—mme o akanye sentle pele o letla Colonel van der Merwe go tsenya diketane mo isagong."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_de: "Motho yo o batliwang? Ka diperesente tse masome-pedi le botlhano tsa Sovereign Pearl Holdings mo polokelong ya Dubai, ba tla mpitsa mokaedi wa tshireletso ya boditšhabatšhaba! Tloga mo tseleng ya lebili la nko, kgotsa o dire tshameko ya gago ya bofelo fano!"
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.mokoena_act2_mu: "Unit 3 le Unit 5 di ya kae?! A re go rogake, Sbu—o dirile gore di-sergeant tsa me di ntlhasele! Motho mongwe le mongwe o itirela mo tseleng ya difofane!"
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p1: "Bofelo jwa tsela ya difofane, Sbu! Di-engine tsa Gulfstream di a thutha, tetla ya dipuisano e tsentshitswe, mme di-pallet jack di tsenya dikrate tsa bofelo mo teng."
dialogue.n12_cargo_apron.root.p2: "O falotse N2, o falotse Pier 2, mme o falotse setlhopha sa me sa go bolaya. Bua mafoko a gago pele dikerese tsa go palama di boela morago!"
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p1: "Dikoloi tse pedi tsa mabone a a botala di re thibile fa morago ga Umgeni off-ramp. Brigadier Mokoena o ne a sa apara le mask. O tswile a apere diaparo tsa gagwe tsa TRT, a lebelela briefcase ya ga Sithole, mme a raya corporal wa gagwe a re a thube koloi."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ambush_details.p2: "Ke theleletse kwa tlase ga noka le folder ya manila ka fa tlase ga hempe ya me. Fa Sparks kwa Golden Dragon a ka kgona go thuba founu ya ga Sithole, lentswe la ga Mokoena le mo go yone."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.dockets_breakthrou: "Bona—dipoleiti ND-449-102 go ya go 118. Ba biditse City Hall diranta di le dimilione di le masome a mane le bobedi go isa metsi kwa KwaMashu ka nako ya komelelo, mme lebelela di-toll tag tsa disele. Ga ba ise ba tsamaye kwa bokone."
"Tanke nngwe le nngwe e kgweetseditse kwa Pier 2 Cold Storage ka 01:30 AM. Ba rwala dikhemikale tsa ga Zuko Ndlovu ba di fitlhile ka ditanka tsa metsi."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p1: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics... diperesente di le masome a marataro ke tsa Abasanta Maritime, diperesente di le masome a mane ke tsa lelapa la ga Ma-Sibi. O e kgonne, Sbu."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.ledger_reaction.p2: "Isa seno go Colonel van der Merwe kwa Old Archive Basement—kgotsa o thube Berth 14 wena ka bowena. Le fa go ka nna jang, ga ba kitla ba tswa mo go seno ba se na molato."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.name: Constable Nandi
dialogue.n1_safehouse.role: Moitsisi wa Sephiri yo o Gobetseng • Mosupi yo Mogolo
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p1: "Se bule dikharetene, Sbu. Di-Golf GTI tsa ga Mokoena tse di se nang mebala di dikologa Anton Lembede Street metsotso e mengwe le e mengwe e le masome a mabedi. Ga ba a bolaya Auditor Sithole fela kwa Umgeni weighbridge—ba ne ba mo emetse ba setse ba phimotse di-transponder tsa boemakepe."
dialogue.n1_safehouse.root.p2: "Sengwe le sengwe se Sithole a swetseng ka sone se mo Docket #409 le mo founung eo e thubegileng. Mpolelele gore ga re swele mo ntlong eno bosigo jwa gompieno."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.role: Queen Street Taxi Boss • Syndicate Fixer
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p1: "Hawu, ex-Hawk o tsena mo Queen Street fa basimane ba ga Mokoena ba TRT ba pitikolola dikoloi kwa Warwick Junction. O pelokgale, Sbu, ke a go dumela."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.root.p2: "Ga go na sepe se se tsamayang mo CBD ntle le gore bakhweetsi ba me ba se bone—le di-Nyalas tsa SAPS, le ditanka tseo tsa metsi tse di tsamayang ka nako ya bobedi bosigo."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.street_favor.p1: "Ga o ise o lebale gore mmila o dira jang, Sbu. Go dirilwe. Dikoloi tsa me di le tharo di thibile koloi ya SAPS kwa Monty Naicker Road. O na le nako ya go hema."
"Tsaya seno mo mading a rona a ntwa. Reka disele, reka mookamedi, kgotsa o thuse Nandi. Fela tlhomamisa gore Mokoena o a utlwa ka ntlha ya go re kgama."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p1: "Reetsa sentle. Ditanka tseo di na le di-decal tsa City Hall mo dikorong, nnete? Mme basimane ba me ba ba dirang bosigo kwa Umbilo ba re maotwana a a kgobogile ka ntlha ya boima jwa dikhemikale, mme batho ba ga Abasanta ba ba thunyang ba ntse mo dikoloing tsa Golf R."
dialogue.n2_taxi_rank.tanker_rumors.p2: "Fa bo-mme ba rona kwa KwaMashu ba eme mo molaong ka dibakete kwa dipompong tse di omeletseng. Councillor Ma-Sibi o rekisa batho ba gagwe."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sha: "Jaanong Hawk yo o nang le maikemisetso o ithutile tlhwatlhwa ya nama mo eThekwini. Tsaya madi a a neng a tsewa mo locker. Boloka faele eo ya modumo e se ka ya fitlha mo tafoleng ya Colonel van der Merwe, mme gongwe Zuko o tla go tlogela o phela go fitlha beke e e tlang."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_sta: "...Kgaotsa Car 4 le Car 7 mo karolong ya Victoria Embankment. O ne o ntse o itse go tshameka tšheše ya bopolotiki, Sbu. Itumelele diura tse di masome a mabedi le bone tse di oketsegileng—ga di kitla di go boloka fa Berth 14 e phuthulwa."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.mokoena_thr: "Durban e tsamaya ka taolo, Sbu. Zuko o boloka boemakepe bo didimetse, Ma-Sibi o boloka motlakase o tshwerwe kwa City Hall, mme Task Force ya me e boloka kagiso. Mandla Sithole o ne a akanya gore spreadsheet e ka emisa terena ya dithoto."
"Neela Nandi pele ga mpa ya bosigo ka Letsatsi la 4, kgotsa banna ba me ba ka se itlhokise go kokota kwa mojakong wa gago wa Mercury Arcade."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.name: Brigadier Titus Mokoena
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.role: Molaodi wa SAPS TRT • Mookamedi wa Cartel
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p1: "Aowa, aowa. Bona gore pula ya matsorotsoro e tlisitse eng ofising ya me ya mapodisi. O kgaotswe mo tirong kwa Hawks, Sbu—go tsena mo, ke gore o batla go swa kgotsa o na le mmueledi yo o turang thata."
dialogue.n3_central_precinct.root.p2: "Constable Nandi o kae, mme briefcase ya mookamedi wa ditšhelete wa mmasepala e kae?"
dialogue.n4_city_hall.dockets_fax.p1: "Badiri ba ba nang le bokgoni ga ba bonale mo mmasepaleng ono. Go siame—tsaya pampiri ya tsela ya dithelekhono. O tla fitlhela e lebile tlhamalalo kwa crane ya ga Zuko kwa Berth 14."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p1: "Load shedding ke masetlapelo, Sbu—fa e se fela fa o itse gore ke breaker efe e o tshwanetseng go e goga le gore leng. Fa Stage 6 e itaya Point Waterfront, dikhamera tsa Transnet di nna difofu diura tse nne."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.grid_admission.p2: "Ditsala tsa City Hall ga di nne mo lefifing. Baba ba bone ba fitlhela matlo a bone a tlhasetswe pele ga dipone tsa tsela di buseletswa."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p1: "Mandla Sithole e ne e le mookamedi wa ditšhelete yo o botlhale yo o se nang boitemogelo jwa go falola. Wena, ka fa letlhakoreng le lengwe, o tlhaloganya maatla a go gatelela."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.ledger_leverage.p2: "Ke eno R500 ya retainer go tswa mo letloleng la kgaolo. Boloka leina la trust ya me le se ka la tlhaga mo dikgannyeng, mme ofisi ya me e ka kgona go laola motlakase wa Eskom fa o tlhoka gore go nne lefifi."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p1: "Tswala lebati, moratiwa, bongola bo senya mahogany. Mongwe le mongwe mo toropong eno o ngongorega fa motlakase o ya kwa Stage 6, mme ga go na ope yo o botsang gore ke mang yo o duelang bopolotiki jwa kopano."
dialogue.n4_city_hall.root.p2: "O ntse o batlisisa Procurement Registry B. Mpolelele gore mmatlisisi yo o kgaotsweng o batlang ka ditlamelo tsa metsi a a potlakileng."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.imsi_sweep.p1: "Ee, Central Precinct e ne e na le stingray tower e e tshwereng serial ya gago ya bogologolo ya SIM. Ke fetotse baseband MAC address ya gago gore e lebege jaaka motšhine wa go duela parking wa mmasepala. Nwa!"
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.name: Sparks
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p1: "Sithole e ne e se fela mookamedi wa ditšhelete—o ne a tsentse maekrofouno kwa Pier 2 Cold Storage. Pele ba thula koloi ya gagwe mo N2, founo ya gagwe e ne ya boloka voice note ya metsotswana e le masome a mane le borobedi le manifest ya container ya MV Southern Cross."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.phone_lore.p2: "Itlhokomele ka blackouts tsa Stage 6, lefa go ntse jalo. Fa o sa dirise jenereitara ya gago ya diesel, rig ya me ya go thuba dikhodo e tla latlhegelwa ke motlakase."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p1: "Itlhokomele tripwire kwa setulong sa megopo, Sbu! Motlakase wa Stage 4 o setse o fisitse di-oscilloscope tsa me tse pedi, mme mapodisi a cyber-crime a ga Mokoena a ntse a batlisisa tora nngwe le nngwe ya selefouno magareng ga Grey Street le boemakepe."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.root.p2: "O ntliseditse GraphemeOS brick ya ga Mandla Sithole? Founo eo e na le Abasanta remote-wipe daemon e e dutseng mo chip ya baseband."
dialogue.n5_cyber_pawn.wire_collab.p1: "Ayoba! Bona nako eo ya motlakase—re kgonne go feta lock ya ntlha ya biometric re sa tsosa Abasanta wipe daemon. Pass e nngwe gape mo tafoleng mme drive eno ke ya gago."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.name: Zuko "The Architect" Ndlovu
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p1: "Lebelela kwa tseleng ya metsi, Sbu. Sekepe tse masome a marataro di letile, dikhontheinara tse dikete tharo ka letsatsi, mme Pretoria e akanya gore pampiri e e saenilweng ke mmusisi e laola boemakepe jono."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.root.p2: "Ke agile Abasanta Logistics go tswa mo shedeng e le nngwe ya cold-storage. Jaanong o eme mo catwalk ya me o tshwere ledger ya mookamedi wa ditšhelete yo o suleng. A o tlile go tshameka mogaka, kgotsa o tlile go tlhaloganya tlhokego le theko?"
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_deal.p1: "Motho yo o botlhale. Hawks ba go duetse madi a mannyane mme ba go latlhela mo diphologolong fa o ne o atamela boammaaruri. Tsaa seno jaaka tuelo ya gago ya ntlha go tswa kwa Berth 14. Fa gare ga bosigo go goroga, tlhomamisa gore convoy eo e tsamaya."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_respect.p1: "Ga go gakgamatse gore setlhopha sa ga Mokoena se go fosele kwa N2. O tsamaya jaaka mosi wa kwa boemakepeng. Bolelela Titus gore ke phimotse balebedi ba gagwe ba boemakepe bosigo jono—fa re ya go lekana maatla, a re direng jalo re se na batho ba ba sa itseng sepe mo tseleng."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p1: "City Hall e utswitse budget ya metsi dingwaga tse lesome pele ke hirisa tanker, Sbu. Ke hirile ditruck tsa bone tse di neng di se na sepe. Mo nageng eno, infrastructure ke ya motho yo o tlhokomelang diesel le go duela balebedi."
dialogue.n6_pier2_port.zuko_vision.p2: "Mokoena ke motho yo o se nang botlhale, mme Ma-Sibi ke motho yo o tshelang ka ba bangwe. Nthuse go phepafatsa Berth 14 bosigo jono, mme ga o kitla o tlhola o sokola ka rente kwa Mercury Arcade gape."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.name: Colonel Piet van der Merwe
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.role: DPCI Hawks Holdout • Clean Task Force
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p1: "O kgonne go feta dikhamera tsa kgotla ya magistrate, Sbu. Go siame. Bontlha bongwe jwa Provincial Headquarters bo mo tuelong ya ga Mokoena, ke ka moo ke fuduseditseng task force ya me kwano le metšhine ya 1980s microfiche."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.root.p2: "O lebega o le mo mathateng, ngwanaka—mme ke utlwile gore Constable Nandi o thuntshitswe kwa N2. Mpolelele gore o tlisitse sengwe se se ka kgonang go emelana le moatlhodi wa High Court."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_audio_s: "Modimo wame... 'thibela sedan ya gagwe pele ga off-ramp ya Umgeni mme o fise briefcase.' Ke lentswe la ga Titus Mokoena leo, le utlwala sentle."
"Ke tsenya koloi ya gago mo registry ya rona ya diplomatic gone jaanong go phimola Precinct Heat ya gago. Nna o tshedile go fitlha re gasa seno, Sbu."
dialogue.n7_archive_basement.vdm_politic: "Ka gonne nako nngwe le nngwe fa ke kwala warrant kwa godimo, mongwe kwa Ministry o bolelela City Hall mo metsotsong e le lesome le botlhano. Kwantle ga financial ledger LE modumo wa Berth 14, moatlhodi o tla latlha tsheko pele ga dijo tsa mosong."
"Fa re romela sephuthelwana sotlhe kwa The Daily Veld newsroom re ntse re sireletsa Nandi, ga ba kake ba se fitlha."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_act2: "E tseye. Lebelela go galefa ga gago kwa Midlands super-lab ya ga Zuko kgotsa kwa bathung ba ga Mokoena—tlogela mosadi yo o tsofetseng a ye go itapolosa kwa Palm Jumeirah."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_duba: "Mongwe le mongwe yo o botlhale kwa KwaZulu-Natal o itse gore Rand ke ya go dirisiwa mme Dirham ke ya go bolokwa. Sovereign Pearl e na le matlo kwa Dubai, polasi ya citrus kwa Midlands, le sefofane kwa Hangar 7."
"Zuko o na le diperesente di le masome mane le botlhano, nna ke na le masome a mararo, mme Titus Mokoena o na le masome a mabedi le botlhano ka go re sireletsa."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.masibi_swif: "O thakile escrow terminal? O na le boikemisetso tota. Go siame—baatlhodi ba ba latelang Contempt Warrant ya gago ba utlwa nna. Ke tla ba bolelela gore ba diegise faele ya gago ya go tshwarwa."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.name: Councillor "Ma-Sibi" Khumalo
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p1: "Moya o phepa thata kwano kwa Ridge, ga go nna jalo, Sbu? Kwa CBD ba tshwere Judicial Commission of Inquiry ya bone, ba itira e kete moatlhodi yo o pensheneng a ka rarabolola dingwaga tse masome a mabedi tsa tshenyetso setšhaba."
dialogue.n8_ridge_penthouses.root.p2: "Disutukheisi tsa me di setse di le kwa King Shaka Hangar 7. Ke ka ntlha yang fa o palama tora ya me ya galase fa setsuatsue se batlile se fela?"
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_gps_inf: "Tsotlhe di ne di ntse jalo! Gare ga 1:00 AM le 4:00 AM, mo boemong jwa go pompa metsi kwa letamong, ditruck tse di ne tsa palama N3 go ya kwa polasing ya citrus gaufi le Howick."
"Rarabolola data eo, Sbu, mme o tla bona kwa super-lab ya ga Zuko e leng teng."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.bheki_street_: "Ke fa flash module go tswa kwa Tanker #14! Mme o se ka wa tshwenyega ka batho bao ba ba hirilweng go tswa Joburg—sedan epe fela e e tsenang mo kgaolong ya bokone e tla dikaganyediwa ke di-Quantum di le masome mane pele ba ka kgona go thuntsha."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.name: Bra Bheki Sithole
dialogue.n9_township_depot.role: Northern Water Strike Marshal • Queen St. Alliance
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p1: "Lebelela ditanker tse re di tsereng bosigo jono, Sbu! Go na le diphaposi tsa maaka tse di tsenyeng mo teng—di omeletse jaaka lerapo mo teng, mme go na le masalela a dikhemikale mo teng."
dialogue.n9_township_depot.root.p2: "Batho ba kwa bokone ba lapile go leta dikomishini tsa High Court. Bakhanni ba me ba tswetse depot, mme izinkabi tsa ga Mokoena di batla wena kwa ditseleng tsa ridge."
dialogue.new_lead_title: Tshekatsheko e ntšha ya dipalo kgotsa bopaki bo bo ntšha bo teng!
dialogue.select_response: Tlhopha Mola wa Dipotsolotso / Karabo (Tuelo ya Ditaese di le 0)
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_exit.label: "Tshwara dikgoro tsa depot, Bra Bheki. Re ya go lwa kwa ntlong ya bone."
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_gps.label: "A ditanker tse di neng di tserwe di ne di sa ntse di na le GPS transponders tsa tsone?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_act2_street.label: [STREET >= 2] "A re ntsheng GPS flash chips mo Lead Tanker #14 gone jaanong mme re tlhame balebedi ba ba tla re thusang kgatlhanong le setlhopha seo."
dialogue_resp.bheki_ask_tankers.label: "Bakhweetsi ba gago ba bosigo ba reng ka ditanka tseo tsa metsi?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_back.label: "Dikgang tse di molemo. A re bue ka se sengwe."
dialogue_resp.bheki_exit.label: "Boloka mabone a gago a le kwa tlase, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_favor_back.label: "Tlotlo, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_gps_back.label: "Ke yone kgokagano e e neng e tlhaela magareng ga boemakepe le boemafofane."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rally_back.label: "Amandla, Bra Bheki."
dialogue_resp.bheki_rep_stipend.label: [Street Syndicate Rep >= 2] "Tumalano ya Queen Street e a ema. A rank e ka nkadima madi a tiro?"
dialogue_resp.bheki_stipend_back.label: "E tla ya go thuba convoy ya bone."
dialogue_resp.bheki_street_check.label: [STREET >= 2] "Balebedi ba gago ba nkolota ka ntlha ya tumalano ya Berea. Phimola dipoleiti tsa me mo go ba ba ntseng ba mpatla."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_back.label: "Karolo e e siameng ya batho ba bararo."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_deed.label: [Present Evidence: Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed] "Ke na le schedule ya beng, Ma-Sibi. Reka boemo jwa gago mo pampiring ya me ya ditsheko."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_exit.label: "O se ka wa palama Gulfstream eo gape, Councillor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_trust.label: "Sovereign Pearl Holdings ke eng, mme ke ka ntlha yang fa Gulfstream e tshetswe lookwane kwa Hangar 7?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_act2_wire.label: [WIRE >= 2] "Mokwaledi wa gago wa madi o lebetse go phimola Dubai SWIFT mirror mo server ya floor ya bo-28."
dialogue_resp.masibi_ask_grid.label: "Ke ka ntlha yang fa Sub-Station 14 e tima nako nngwe le nngwe fa Pier 2 e phuthulwa bosigo?"
dialogue_resp.masibi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Mogwebi wa gago o tlogetse thulaganyo ya Sub-Station 14 mo motšhineng wa fekese. Ke kopitsa nako ya go tima motlakase kwa boemakepeng."
dialogue_resp.masibi_exit.label: "Itumelele air-conditioning fa e sa ntse e bereka, Councillor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_fax_back.label: "Ke lebogile thata, Councillor."
dialogue_resp.masibi_grid_back.label: "Thulaganyo e e siameng."
dialogue_resp.masibi_leverage_back.label: "Ke tla tsaya retainer. Re tla bona ka dikgang."
dialogue_resp.masibi_payoff_back.label: "Re tla bona gore ke mang yo o tsamayang ka sefofane."
dialogue_resp.masibi_present_ledger.labe: [Present Evidence: Decoded Water-Tanker Ledger] "Masome a mane a lekgolo a Zululand Aqua-Logistics ke a trust ya lelapa la gago, Ma-Sibi."
dialogue_resp.masibi_swift_back.label: "Kgato e e botlhale."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_exit.label: "Nako ya go fedisa seno mo tseleng ya difofane."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_influence.lab: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "Bontsi jwa di-sergeant tsa gago tsa TRT ga di mo sefofaneng seo, Titus. Ke sa tswa go ba bolelela gore o ba tlogela gore ba tseye molato kwa Khomisheneng."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_act2_tarmac.label: "Fa o palama dikerese tseo, Titus, o tla nna motho yo o batliwang ke mapodisi botshelo jotlhe jwa gago."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_bluff.label: "Ke sekaseka fela pampiri ya ditlolo tsa molao, Brigadier. A o tshwenyegile ka sengwe mo tseleng ya N2?"
dialogue_resp.mokoena_exit.label: "Boroko jo bo monate, Brigadier. Itlhokomele mo lefifing."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_influence_check.la: [INFLUENCE >= 2] "Internal Affairs kwa Pretoria ba setse ba na le khopi ya Docket #409. Kgaotsa go batlisisa kgotsa rotlhe re tla tuka."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_mutiny_back.label: "Tsela ya difofane e bulegile. A re fediseng seno."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_present_manifest.l: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Ke na le lentswe la gago mo theipong o laela gore go tlhaselwe kwa Umgeni, Titus. Ntsholele madi gore ke latlhe khopi eo."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_shakedown_back.lab: "Re tla bona gore sekoloto sa gago se tla nna nako e kae."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_standdown_back.lab: "Go itumedisa go dira kgwebo le taolo ya SAPS."
dialogue_resp.mokoena_threat_back.label: "Tshwara mogopolo oo, Titus."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ask_ambush.label: "Ntlhalosetse gape ka ga tlhaselo ya kwa N2 weighbridge. Ke mang yo o thunnyeng?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_back_root.label: "A re boele mo dikgethong tsa rona."
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_back.label: "Se se ntsheditse nako ya go lekola di-ledger. Nna o tiile."
dialogue_resp.nandi_dockets_check.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "Lebelela dinako tseno tsa weighbridge le nna. Ke dipoleiti dife tsa ditanka tse di neng di sa bonale?"
dialogue_resp.nandi_exit.label: "Itapolose, Nandi. Tswala lebati sentle fa nna ke ntse ke dira mo mmileng."
dialogue_resp.nandi_leave_ambush.label: "Ke tla tlhomamisa gore lentswe leo le a utlwala."
dialogue_resp.nandi_ledger_back.label: "O se ka wa tsamaya. Re tsena mo bogareng jwa ntwano."
dialogue_resp.nandi_show_ledger.label: [Present Evidence: Decoded Water-Tanker Ledger] "Ke latetse khampani eo. Ma-Sibi le Zuko ke bone beng ba ditanka."
dialogue_resp.sparks_ask_phone.label: "Go na le eng mo founong ya mookamedi wa ditšhelete se se dirang gore Zuko le Mokoena ba boife thata?"
dialogue_resp.sparks_coffee_stim.label: [Pay R100] "Tsenya pitsa ya kofi ya Ethiopian mo gas burner mme o sekaseke founo ya me ya burner gore go se nne le di-IMSI-catcher tsa SAPS."
dialogue_resp.sparks_collab_back.label: "Go tjheseletsa ga gago go siame, Sparks."

dialogue_resp.sparks_imsi_back.label: "E a ntshegetsa."
dialogue_resp.sparks_lore_back.label: "Go siame go itse. A re sekasekeng tafole."
dialogue_resp.sparks_wire_check.label: [WIRE >= 2] "A re kopanyeng di-pin tsa JTAG mo teng ga Faraday cage pele baseband e romela sesupo kwa torong."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_dockets.label: [DOCKETS >= 2] "A re tsenyeng kopo ya tshoganyetso ya go ganetsa warrant ya Contempt le go bitsa direkoto tsa escrow tsa Ridge."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_exit.label: "Tshwara Khomishene e ntse e tsweletse, Colonel. Ke ya go tsoma."
dialogue_resp.vdm_act2_plan.label: "Re tlhoka eng go emisa Flight ZS-900 le go ba fedisa gotlhelele?"
dialogue_resp.vdm_ask_hawks.label: "Ke ka ntlha yang fa Hawks ba ise ba tshware Mokoena le Ma-Sibi, Colonel?"
dialogue_resp.vdm_audio_back.label: "Ke a leboga, Colonel."
dialogue_resp.vdm_briefing_back.label: "Go utlwala, Colonel."
dialogue_resp.vdm_exit.label: "Tshwara lebati le le thata, Colonel. Ke batlile ke itekanetse."
dialogue_resp.vdm_motion_back.label: "A re diriseng tshono e."
dialogue_resp.vdm_politics_back.label: "Jaanong re tla tlolaganya ba kwa godimo gotlhelele."
dialogue_resp.vdm_present_both.label: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Reetsa faele eno ya modumo, Colonel. Mokoena o laetse gore go thuntshiwe kwa N2 ka boene."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_exit.label: "Re tla bonana kwa Hangar 7, Zuko."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_present_telemetr: [Present Evidence: Super-Lab Telemetry] "Nomoro nngwe le nngwe ya batch le tsela ya tanka di setse di kopitsitswe kwa ntle. Emisa setlhopha sa gago sa izinkabi mme o duele lekgetho la phetogo."
dialogue_resp.zuko_act2_why.label: "O ya Dubai ka Flight ZS-900 bosigo jono. A Architect o a boifa?"
dialogue_resp.zuko_deal_back.label: "Re tla bona gore gare ga bosigo go tla le eng."
dialogue_resp.zuko_exit.label: "Re tla rarabolola seno fa convoy ya fa gare ga bosigo e tsamaya, Zuko."
dialogue_resp.zuko_manifesto_back.label: "Re tla dira kgetho eo kwa Hangar 7."
dialogue_resp.zuko_philosophy.label: "O ntse o tsenya botlhole mo metsing a ditoropo go rwala dikhemikale, Zuko."
dialogue_resp.zuko_present_manifest.labe: [Present Evidence: Berth 14 Manifest] "Container MSCU-908114 e na le mathata. Nke o nkenye mo go tsa logistics kgotsa Hawks ba tla tsena mo MV Southern Cross."
dialogue_resp.zuko_respect_back.label: "Go fitlha gare ga bosigo kwa Berth 14."
dialogue_resp.zuko_street_spot.label: [STREET >= 2] "Balebedi ba gago ba crane kwa Berth 14 ba sa tswa go fetola shift. Ke setse ke bone gore blind spot e fa kae gaufi le fuel valves."
dialogue_resp.zuko_truce_back.label: "Ke tla go bona kwa boemafofaneng."
dialogue_resp.zuko_vision_back.label: "Mongwe le mongwe yo o eteletseng pele o akanya gore ke rafilosofi."

ending.ending_act2_reckoning.hook: LETŠOLO LE FEDILE (KGAOLO 1 + KGAOLO 2): O falotse go tima ga motlakase, o utolotse maano a Sovereign Pearl, mme o tlisitse ba ba sa tshwaregeng ba eThekwini-Gold kwa tolong.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p1: As Gulfstream ZS-900 turns onto the active taxiway, four unmarked Hawks interceptors and a High Court sheriff’s van block the nose gear. You step out into the blinding sodium glare holding the certified Sovereign Pearl Trust Deed and the Midlands super-lab batch logs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p2: Brigadier Mokoena reaches for his holster, but seeing twenty DPCI rifles trained on the airstairs—and a live broadcast camera streaming directly to the Commission’s emergency feed—he slowly lowers his weapon. Councillor Ma-Sibi and Zuko Ndlovu are led down the wet stairs in steel cuffs.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.p3: By morning, the KwaZulu-Natal High Court places Zululand Aqua-Logistics under judicial administration, and the northern township reservoirs open to full pressure for the first time in a year.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.quote: "Lwantlha mo dingwageng tse masome a mabedi, di-siren tsa mapodisi di ne di sa tlosa sephethephethe go direla ba-VIP—di ne di ba tshwara ka diketane."
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift1.summ: Zuko Ndlovu, Councillor Ma-Sibi, and Brigadier Mokoena face 142 counts of racketeering, treasonous sabotage, and murder before a special High Court tribunal.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift2.summ: Forensic teams seize R1.2 billion in offshore escrow and dismantle the Howick hydroponic precursor plant.
ending.ending_act2_reckoning.shift3.summ: Promoted to Major in the rebuilt DPCI Organised Crime Directorate, you and Constable Nandi take over the 13th Floor of Central Seteišene sa Mapodisi.

ending.ending_act2_revolution.hook: LETŠOLO LE FEDILE (KGAOLO 1 + KGAOLO 2): O thubile setlhopha sa go thapiwa ga puso mme wa busetsa botshelo jwa eThekwini-Gold kwa bathong.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p1: Instead of waiting for slow court orders, you broadcast the Hangar 7 coordinates and the Sovereign Pearl escrow keys directly to Bra Bheki’s Queen Street marshals and the Northern Township strike committees.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p2: Within thirty minutes, three hundred minibus taxis and forty hijacked municipal water tankers smash through the cargo apron perimeter fence, surrounding Gulfstream ZS-900 on the runway. Zuko’s mercenaries drop their rifles and flee into the sugarcane fields.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.p3: Before sunrise, the Lekgotla la Bosenyi’s R400 million liquid escrow is wired directly into community water cooperatives, and a convoy of freshly flushed tankers rolls into KwaMashu with sirens blaring in celebration.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.quote: "Ba utswile metsi mme ba re rekisetsa komelelo. Bosigo jono re tsere ditruck, dipompo, le akhaonto ya banka."
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift1.sum: The Northern Township Water Forum seizes permanent control of the municipal tanker fleet, ending the artificial drought overnight.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift2.sum: Stripped of both their Setlhopha sa Bosenyi protection and offshore slush funds, Ma-Sibi’s coalition resigns en masse amid citywide street celebrations.
ending.ending_act2_revolution.shift3.sum: Every minibus from Point Road to the Midlands carries your callsign on the rear window—the outlaw Hawk who gave the city back to its streets.

ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.hook: LETŠOLO LE FEDILE (KGAOLO 1 + KGAOLO 2): O fentse setlhopha sengwe le sengwe mo eThekwini-Gold mme wa tsaya bogosi jwa puso ya moriti.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p1: You stand alone in the rain at Hangar 7 with your thumb on the encrypted broadcast switch. Zuko Ndlovu looks at the High Court subpoena in your left hand and the Dubai flight plan in your right, then smiles and signs the transfer of Sovereign Pearl Holdings.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p2: At 00:05 AM, you call off the Hawks interceptors and watch Gulfstream ZS-900 climb into the storm clouds toward the Indian Ocean. Ten minutes later, Colonel van der Merwe receives a sanitized Kgetsi ya Molato pinning the entire conspiracy on a dead deputy clerk.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.p3: From the top floor of the Umhlanga Ridge glass tower, you watch Stage 6 plunge the city below into darkness—while your private turbines hum without a flicker.
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.quote: "Mmuso ga o we fa kgosi e palama sefofane. Ba fetola fela ditshaeno mo pampiring ya tshepo."
ending.ending_act2_syndicate_state.shift: With Zuko, Ma-Sibi, and Mokoena exiled in Dubai, you assume 100% control of Sovereign Pearl Holdings, the Boemakepe cranes, and the Midlands estate.
The State Capture Inquiry releases a toothless 900-page report recommending "administrative reforms" with zero high-profile convictions.
You own the judges, the taxi ranks, and the municipal tenders. In eThekwini-Gold, midnight now belongs to you.

ending.ending_act2_vanished.hook: LEKA KGAOLO 2 GAPE: Fetsa nako ya "Trace Sovereign Pearl Trust" (kwa The Ridge kgotsa Kgotla ya Kwa Godimo) kgotsa nako ya "Synthesize Super-Lab Telemetry" (kwa Northern Township Depot) pele o thibela Flight ZS-900!
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p1: Arriving at Hangar 7 without certified proof of either the Sovereign Pearl trust or the Midlands batch telemetry leaves you exposed on the open tarmac. When Stage 6 cuts the airport perimeter lights, Brigadier Mokoena’s sniper team pins your vehicle behind a cargo loader.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p2: Gulfstream ZS-900 roars down the runway and lifts into the coastal clouds carrying every original Buka ya Ditshenyegelo and witness out of South African jurisdiction.
ending.ending_act2_vanished.p3: Three weeks later, the Commission of Inquiry closes its proceedings behind locked doors, sealing your uncorroborated testimony in the National Archives for fifty years.

ending.ending_captured.p1: Exhausted, broke, and boxed in by Operation Shanela roadblocks, your trail finally runs out in the rain-swept alleys behind Queen Street. When the grid drops to Stage 6, the streetlights die—and four unmarked TRT Volkswagen Golfs box you against the shuttered roller doors.
ending.ending_captured.p2: Brigadier Mokoena doesn’t read you your rights. He pulls Kgetsi ya Molato #409 and the dead auditor’s phone from your coat pocket, checks the seal, and nods to Sergeant Dlamini.
ending.ending_captured.p3: By the time the morning commuters crowd the taxi rank, theMercury Arcade flat has been scrubbed Phepafetse, and another anonymous dossier has vanished into the furnace of eThekwini-Gold.

ending.ending_kingpin.p1: The private elevator to The Glass House rises above the rusted container cranes into air-conditioned silence. Zuko Ndlovu pours two glasses of single malt while Brigadier Mokoena and Councillor Ma-Sibi’s Chief of Staff watch you lay the bloodstained original pages of Kgetsi ya Molato #409 and the auditor’s decrypted drive onto the glass table.
ending.ending_kingpin.p2: "Logistics is about removing friction," Zuko says softly, looking out over the darkened city grid. "You proved more capable than Brigadier Mokoena’s entire regiment. Name your tariff."
ending.ending_kingpin.p3: You strike the match yourself. As the original forensic annexures curl into ash, your suspension is wiped from the SAPS mainframe, Constable Nandi’s name is cleared with a quiet medical pension, and your newly registered consulting firm is awarded 20% of the Zululand Aqua-Logistics pipeline.

ending.ending_vigilante.p1: When Stage 6 kills the Boemakepe floodlights at midnight, Bra Bheki’s minibus convoy cuts its headlights and blocks the Pier 2 weighbridge. Fifteen heavily armed izinkabi step out from behind the rusting container stacks just as Brigadier Mokoena’s unmarked TRT vans escort the municipal water tankers onto Berth 14.
ending.ending_vigilante.p2: The firefight echoes across the Natal Port Channel for twenty minutes. Punctured chemical drums spill across the wet asphalt, catching a tracer round and sending a wall of orange flame forty metres into the humid night sky.
ending.ending_vigilante.p3: In the chaos, you breach the lead armoured command van, haul out two steel cases of Abasanta bearer Madi a a Mo Matsogong, and pull Constable Nandi into your getaway car before the port sirens even spin up.

ending.ending_whistleblower.hook: ACT 2 PREVIEW: Fa Mokoena a ntse a taboga jaaka mmolai mme Nandi a ipaakanyetsa go supa kwa High Court, o tshwanetse go boloka mosupi wa gago a tshedile ka diura di le 72.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p1: At 04:00 AM, Colonel Piet van der Merwe’s loyal Hawks task force seals the steel blast doors of the Old Bobolokelo jwa Ditso Phaposi e e ka Fa Tlase. While Constable Nandi is smuggled onto a light aircraft bound for a witness-protection safe farm in the Drakensberg, you upload the decrypted Berth 14 audio and the audited Zululand Aqua-Logistics ledgers to every independent newsroom in the country.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p2: By sunrise, Brigadier Mokoena’s voice—ordering the execution of the municipal auditor and clearing the N2 weighbridge for Zuko’s chemical tankers—is playing on every taxi radio and morning news bulletin from Durban to Johannesburg.
ending.ending_whistleblower.p3: Outside City Hall, thousands of residents whose taps have been dry for months flood the streets, surrounding Councillor Ma-Sibi’s motorcade.

event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p1: Pula ya mofuthu ya kwa lotshitshing e itaya khonkreiti ya Hangar 7. Di-turbine tsa Rolls-Royce tsa Gulfstream ZS-900 di duma fa di ntse di emetse fa di-forklift di tsenya diphalete tsa bofelo tsa dibonto le diphuthelwana tsa dipolotiki mo teng.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p2: Kwa tlase ga ditepisi tsa sefofane go eme baagi ba bararo ba go thapiwa ga eThekwini-Gold: Zuko Ndlovu a apere kobo ya gagwe e e phepa, Councillor Ma-Sibi a tshwere paseporo ya gagwe ya dipolotiki, le Brigadier Mokoena a supegetse tlhobolo ya gagwe kwa tarmac e e metsi.
event.evt_act2_climax_tarmac.p3: "Metsotso e mehlano pele re tloga, Warrant Officer," Zuko o goa go feta modumo wa jet. "Itlhophele gore ke lefatshe le le ntseng jang le o tla tsogang o le fitlhela ka moso."

event.evt_climax_berth14.p1: Pula e na thata kwa Natal Port Channel fa dikrane tse dikgolo tsa Pier 2 di bonala mo phapheng. Kwa tlase ga Berth 14, ditankara di le tharo tsa metsi di letile fa thoko ga dikontena tsa ga Zuko Ndlovu, di dikaganyeditswe ke di-Nyalas tsa TRT tsa ga Brigadier Mokoena.
event.evt_climax_berth14.p2: Nako ya gago e fedile. Le fa o tsile ka di-ledger tsa madi, di-voice note tsa modiredi, kgotsa maatla a gago, o na le tshono e le nngwe fela ya go dira tshwetso pele ga koloi e tsamaya mo tseleng ya N2.

event.evt_composure_breakdown.p2: O itlhagela mo dikereng tsa Mercury Arcade, o lwantsha go hema. Fa o sa ritibale jaanong, o tla dira phoso e e tla go bolayang.

event.evt_docket_decoded.p1: O ala ditsebe tse di nang le madi tsa Docket #409 mo tafoleng ya gago fa tlase ga lebone la inverter. Dipalo di simolola go utlwala.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p2: "Zululand Aqua-Logistics" e rometse City Hall madi a R400 million go isa metsi kwa ditoropong tsa bokone. Mme di-log tsa GPS di supa gore ditankara tseo ga di a ya kwa ditoropong—di tsamaile go tswa kwa Pier 2 Cold Storage go ya kwa matlo-polokelong a kwa ntle ga toropo, di sireleditswe ke di-van tsa TRT tsa ga Brigadier Mokoena.
event.evt_docket_decoded.p3: Councillor Ma-Sibi ga a utswe madi a metsi fela. Ditankara tsa gagwe di rwala dikhemikale tse di dirisediwang go dira methamphetamine kwa di-lab tsa ga Zuko Ndlovu.

event.evt_morning_cable_theft.p2: Marshals a ga Bra Bheki a tshotse ditsela ka di-whistle le disjambok, fa dipatrol van tsa SAPS di kgatlhegile dikilomitara di le pedi go tswa foo.

event.evt_morning_masibi_wire.p2: "Warrant Officer. Re itse gore Constable Nandi o go tliseditse dipampiri tsa ga Mandla Sithole. Ga go na ope kwa City Hall yo o batlang phitlho e nngwe. Fokotsa tiro ya gago ya audit gompieno, mme retainer ya R800 ya consulting ya masepala e tla bo e le mo lepokising la gago la poso mo ura e le nngwe."

event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p1: Lekgaba la sekepe le duma mo phoka ya boemakepe fa sekepe sa dikhontheinara sa MV Southern Cross se tswa mo metsing. Radio ya gago e e sireleditsweng e duma ka lentswe la ga Colonel van der Merwe.
event.evt_morning_port_tipoff.p2: "Reetsa sentle. Ditanka tsa dikhemikale tsa ga Zuko Ndlovu di a folosiwa kwa Berth 14 bosigo jwa gompieno, mme di-van tsa TRT tsa ga Mokoena di setse di eme kwa weighbridge. event.evt_nandi_critical.p2: Fa o mo isa kwa Addington kgotsa kwa Inkosi Albert Luthuli Hospital, rejistara ya dikgobalo tsa lerumo e tla tsosa Brigadier Mokoena mo metsotsong e le masome a mabedi.

event.evt_phone_decrypted.p2: Mo rekotong, lentswe la ga Brigadier Mokoena le utlwala sentle: "Tlosang N2 weighbridge ka gare ga bosigo. Kontena ya ga Zuko e tla fologa kwa Berth 14, mme mongwe le mongwe wa Hawks yo o tla batlang go itse, o tla fitlhelwa kwa moepong wa meepo."

intro.pitch: Dikgweding tse thataro tse di fetileng, Brigadier Titus Mokoena o go pharile ka molato wa maaka mme a fitlha beche ya gago ya Hawks. Bosigong jono, ka nako ya kgaolo ya motlakase ya Stage 4 mo losing lwa lewatle, molekane wa gago wa pele o tsena mo foleteng ya gago ya Mercury Arcade a tswa madi ka ntlha ya ntho ya thobolo—a tshotse buka e e nang le madi e e kopanyang dithendara tsa dilerori tsa metsi tsa City Hall tsa R400m ka tlhamalalo le segopa sa diokobatsi sa Abasanta.
intro.pitch_story2: Tshenyo ya maano ya go tlhagisa motlakase ya Eskom go pateletsa dithendara tsa tshaoganyetso tsa diesel, tse di tshegeditsweng ke borakgwebo ba tshireletso le ditona tsa tshenyetso-setshaba. Mmatlisisi wa SIU Kagiso "Bra K" Molefe o tshwanetse go tsena mo meleteng e e boteng ya meepo ya Johannesburg le matlong a Sandton pele mafaratlhatlha a gosomana.
intro.pitch_story3: Ditetlelelo tse di sa kwadisiwang tsa go epa ditaemane mo botebong jwa lewatle, go tlisiwa ga dibetsa go kgabaganya melelwane, le masole a dikepe tsa sephiri a a phepafatsang madi a maatla go nna majwe a kgotlhang ya boditshabatshaba mo lotshitshing lwa Atlantic lo lo aparetsweng ke mouwane kwa Port Nolloth le Richtersveld.
intro.pitch_story4: Kopano ya moriti ya balaodi ba mapodisi a kgaolo, ditlhopha tse di kopaneng tsa dirukhutlhi tsa Cape Flats, le borakgwebo ba hisitori ba Winelands ba ba tlamelang sesole sa tshireletso sa poraefete ka dibetsa go laola itsholelo ya bosigo le maemelakepe a go romela kwa ntle. Mmatlisisi wa pele wa Yuniti ya Kgatlhanong le Dirukhutlhi Leila Hendricks o batlisisa go tswa Camps Bay go ya mafelong a beine a Stellenbosch.

mission.classified_exhibits_header: Bopaki jo bo Fitlhegileng le Didirisiwa tsa Mmaraka o Montsho:
mission.faq_q1_body: Cycle ke Letsatsi le le 1 mo Motshamekong (shift ya diura di le 24). Ga gona bokhutlo bo bo tlhomilweng jaaka malatsi a le 50 kgotsa 100. Go na le moo, o gaisana le Dithulaganyo tsa Matshosetsi a a Tswelelang (jaaka tshekatsheko ya ga Mokoena ya dikarolo tse 6). Patlisiso e e tlwaelegileng e tsaya dicycle di le 3 go ya go 6 tsa Karolo 1 le di le 4 go ya go 8 tsa Karolo 2.
mission.faq_q1_title: 1. "Cycle" ke eng gape go na le tse kae?
mission.faq_q2_body: Moso mongwe le mongwe, o latlhela ditaese di le 3 go ya go 5 TSA BOTLHE tsa motse otlhe go ya ka Boitshoko jwa gago (80%+ = ditaese di le 5, 40–79% = ditaese di le 4, <40% = ditaese di le 3). GA O latlhele ditaese mo mafelong otlhe! O tlhopha dikgato tsa botlhokwa di le 3 go ya go 5 mo mmepeng go tsenya matsapa a gago a letsatsi.
mission.faq_q2_title: 2. Ke bona ditaese di le kae? A ke latlhela ditaese mo mafelong otlhe?
mission.faq_q3_body:
Go tobetsa Fetsa Cycle go fetsa shift ya gago mme go tswelela kwa mosong o o latelang:
• Dithulaganyo tsa Matshosetsi di a tswelela (+1 karolo mo diureng tse dikhibidu).
• Kgaolo ya motlakase e a dikologa (Stage 2 → 4 → 6 → 2).
• Molaetsa o o Fitlhegileng wa Masa o a goroga ka dikgang tse dintsha tsa kgang.
• O latlhela ditaese tse dintsha kamoso mo mosong.
mission.faq_q3_title: 3. Go diragala eng fa ke tobetsa "Fetsa Cycle / Robala"?
mission.faq_q4_body: Tirei ya kwa tlase e supa "X e e leng teng • Y e e dirisitsweng". Ditaese tse di dirisitsweng di nna le mmala o montsho wa lore o o lefifi mme di supa letshwao la [E DIRISITSWE]. Ditaese tse di leng teng ke diboloko tse di phatsimang tse di nang le dinomoro kgotsa matheba a gauta.
mission.faq_q4_title: 4. Ke itse jang gore ke ditaese dife tse di dirisitsweng le tse di leng teng?
mission.faq_q5_body: Ee! Fa tshekatsheko ya ga Mokoena e fitlha mo go 6/6, folethe ya gago e a phuruphutshwa mme o a tshwarwa. Fa go tswa madi ga ga Constable Nandi go fitlha mo go 4/4 pele o mo thuse, o a swa mo foleteng ya gago (-30% Boitshoko). Fa Boitshoko jwa gago bo fitlha mo go 0%, o simolola Blackout Paranoia!
mission.faq_q5_title: 5. A moanegwa wa me a ka swa kgotsa a baka Game Over?

pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p1: Ka ura ya bobedi mo mosong, motlakase wa mmasepala o tima ka modumo o o boima kwa substation ya Queen Street. Fene ya siling e a ema. Kwa ntle ga difensetere tsa gago, pula ya lebopo e itaya marulelo a tshipi ya Mercury Arcade, e bonesitswe fela ke lesedi la jenereitara ya disela ya spaza shop kwa molaong.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p2: Mo tafoleng ya gago go na le botlolo ya cane spirits e e setseng halofo le lekwalo la go emisiwa tiro le le saenilweng ke Brigadier Titus Mokoena dikgwedi tse thataro tse di fetileng.
pnode.scene_1_wakeup.p3: Go utlwala modumo—e seng kwa kgorong ya kwa tlase, mme ke go itaya ga mararo mo kgorong ya gago ya tshipi ya Trellidor kwa godimo ga fire escape. Pele o tshwara 9mm Parabellum e e fa tlase ga moseme wa gago, gopola gore o ne o mang pele ga Mokoena a fitlha tiro ya gago:
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p1: O baakanya Z88 ya gago mme o ema fa thoko ga kgoro. Ka leihlo la kgoro, lebone la tshoganyetso le bonesa baki ya SAPS e e kolobileng.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p2: Ke Constable Nandi—rookie a le mongwe fela mo seteisheneng yo o ganileng go saena affidavit ya maaka ya ga Mokoena kgatlhanong le wena. O tshwere dikgopo tsa gagwe tsa molema, madi a a lefifi a tswa fa gare ga menwana ya gagwe, a tshwere docket ya brown le smartphone e e thubegileng fa tlase ga letsogo la gagwe.
pnode.scene_2_the_door.p3: "Warrant..." o a hemela, matlho a gagwe a leba moriti wa ditepisi. "Bula kgoro. Tsweetswee. Di-van tsa TRT tsa ga Mokoena di sa tswa go feta kwa ditekesing. Fa transponder ya radio ya me e sa ntse e bereka, ba dikhilomithara di le pedi fela kwa morago ga me."
pnode.scene_2_the_door.role: SAPS Mapodisi a Terena e e Bonako le Mmila o Mogolo (Moithuti wa Gago wa Pele)
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p1: O gatisa thaole e e phepa mo letlhakoreng la gagwe. 9mm hollow-point e mo thuntse fa tlase ga dikgopo—e tsene boteng go tswa madi, e kotsi thata go rokwa kwa sepatela sa puso kwa makwaledi a mapodisi a kwalang motho mongwe le mongwe yo o thuntsweng.
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p2: Nandi o go neela Docket #409 le smartphone e e tletseng madi. "Re arabetse bogodu jwa Cash-in-Transit kwa N2 south ramp fa gare ga bosigo. Van ya G4S e thuthuditswe ka C4, Warrant. Fela go ne go se na madi mo teng."
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.p3: O metsa mathe, a roroma. "Go ne go na le molatodi wa mmasepala yo o suleng a tlhamilwe ka diketane kwa tlase, le buka eno. Dimilione di le nne tsa Ranta mo dithendareng tsa ditankara tsa metsi tse di fetisitsweng ka ofisi ya Councillor Ma-Sibi go ya kwa di-warehouse tsa boemakepe tsa ga Zuko Ndlovu. Fa molekane wa me a leka go e kwala, Brigadier Mokoena o ne a tla ka bakkie ya TRT e se na nomoro... mme a mo thunya mo sehuba."
pnode.scene_3_the_ambush.role: Moitsisi wa Sephiri yo o Gobetseng
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p1: Nandi o idibala mo sofa ya gago fa lesedi la moso le le immetse le phatsima mo difensetereng. Kwa ntle, ditekesi tsa minibus di simolola go letsa dinaka kwa Queen Street.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p2: O na le mathata a mabedi a a go tshwenyang: ntho ya sethunya ya ga Nandi e tla bola mo malatsing a mane fa o sa duele ngaka e e dirang ka sephiri (R1,500), mme ditlhopha tsa TRT tsa Brigadier Mokoena di ntse di phuruphutsha kgaolo nngwe le nngwe.
pnode.scene_4_the_squeeze.p3: Mo diatleng tsa gago go na le bosupi jo bo golaganyang City Hall, SAPS Organized Crime, le Abasanta Cartel. Ditaese tsa gago tsa letsatsi di setse di itekanetse mo tafoleng.

tutorial.step1.badge: KGATO YA 1 MO GO 6 // BARA YA KWA TLASE LE MOELETSI
tutorial.step1.bullet1: Tobetsa taele nngwe le nngwe mo tereing ya kwa tlase go e tshwara—Sekgoba sengwe le sengwe sa Tiro se bontsha palogotlhe ya gago e e fetotsweng (Botala 6+, Bosetlha 4–5, Bohibidu 1–3).
tutorial.step1.bullet2: Ga o na bonnete jwa gore o dire eng morago? Latela "Moeletsi wa Togamaano" mo Phanele ya Molema kgotsa o batle dibetšhe tsa "★ E gakolotswe".
tutorial.step1.bullet3: Fa ditaele tsa gago di fela mo letsatsing, tobetsa "Fetsa Modikologo / Robala →" go tswelela go moso.
tutorial.step1.desc: Moso mongwe le mongwe wa Tikologo (Letsatsi), mmatlisisi wa gago o latlhela ditaese di le 3 go ya go di le 5 tse di nang le matlhakore a marataro go ya ka Boikgapo jwa ga jaana (80–100% = ditaese di le 5, 40–79% = ditaese di le 4, <40% = ditaese di le 3). Boikgapo ke maatla a tlhaloganyo le go itshokela dikhukhu tsa botlokotsebe tsa Durban.
tutorial.step1.title: Kgato 1: Ditaese tsa Ditiro tsa Letsatsi & Boikgapo
tutorial.step1.zone: Ditaele tsa Ditiro tsa Letsatsi le Letsatsi, Boiketlo le Moeletsi wa Togamaano
tutorial.step2.badge: KGATO YA 2 MO GO 6 // LAISI YA MOJENG
tutorial.step2.bullet1: Kgokologo ya Bofelo = Sefatlhego sa Taele + Phetolo ya Dipalo + Bonase ya Kgato 6 + Didirisiwa.
tutorial.step2.bullet2: 6 kgotsa go feta (Botala — Katlego e e Phepa): Tsweletsa Diwatšhe tsa Dipatlisiso ka dikarolo di le +2 kgotsa go duela Diranta.
tutorial.step2.bullet3: 4 kgotsa 5 (Bosetlha — Katlego e e nang le Kotsi): Tsweletsa ka karolo e le +1, mme e ja Boiketlo bo bonnye.
tutorial.step2.bullet4: 1 go ya go 3 (Bohibidu — Go Palelwa / Ditlamorago Tse di Maswe): Ga go tswelelopele, tatlhegelo ya Boiketlo, le Mogote wa Sepodisi.
tutorial.step2.desc: Tshwara kgotsa tobetsa taese go tswa tlase, morago ga moo o tobetse Lefelo la Tiro mo lefelong lengwe le lengwe le le bulegileng mo mmepeng. Dipoelo di bonala ka tlhomamo: Boleng jwa Taese + Phetolo ya Bokgoni + Phetolo ya Lefifi la Stage 6 + Kotlhao ya Lefelo la Babolai. Diteko di bonala sentle: 6+ Katlego e e Phepa, 4–5 Ditlhakatlhano, 1–3 Go Rrepa.
tutorial.step2.title: Kgato 2: Go Baya Ditaese mo Mafelong a Ditiro
tutorial.step2.zone: Dikgoba tsa Ditiro tsa Node le Diphetolo tsa Dipalo
tutorial.step3.badge: KGATO YA 3 MO GO 6 // IKONOMI LE MAATLA
tutorial.step3.bullet1: Lebenkele la Didirisiwa la Sephiri (Godimo ga HUD): Reka ditlhabololo tsa sennelaruri kwa Golden Dragon kgotsa Point Road (+1 WAYA, +1 MMILA).
tutorial.step3.bullet2: Mefala ya Togamaano ya Setlhopha (1 ka Letsatsi): Fitlha go +1/+2 Rep le setlhopha go dira ditiro tsa mahala tsa letsatsi le letsatsi.
tutorial.step3.bullet3: Phediso ya Ntlo ya Tshireletso: Dirisa Diranta mo go Phekolo ya Mahutsana (+25% Boiketlo), Maano a Shebeen, Diesel (R300), le Pipamolomo (R200).
tutorial.step3.desc: Motlakase wa Eskom o dikologa magareng ga Stage 2 -> 4 -> 6 -> 2 bosigo bongwe le bongwe. Ka nako ya Lefifi la Stage 6, mafelo a di-server tsa thekenoloji e e kwa godimo a a tswalwa ntle le fa o dirisa R300 go reka Dizili ya Jenereitara ya Thuso, mme ditiro tsa bokhukhu kwa Boemakepeng le kwa Di-Estate di bona Bonase ya +2 mo Taeseng ka fa tlase ga lefifi.
tutorial.step3.title: Kgato 3: Dikatlego tsa Lefifi (Load Shedding)
tutorial.step3.zone: Diranta (ZAR), Lebenkele la Didirisiwa le Melemo ya Ditlhopha
tutorial.step4.badge: KGATO YA 4 MO GO 6 // MATSHOSETSO LE PHEDISO
tutorial.step4.bullet1: Go Fenngwa / Go Tshwarwa (Tshameko e Fedile): Fa tlhaselo ya ga Brigadier Mokoena e fitlha go 6/6, ntlo ya tshireletso e a thubiwa mme o a tshwarwa.
tutorial.step4.bullet2: Tatlhegelo ya Moanelwa (Lepodisi Nandi): Fa go tswa madi ga ga Nandi go fitlha go 4/4 pele o mo phekola, Nandi o swa ruri mo ntlong ya gago (-30% Boiketlo).
tutorial.step4.bullet3: Go Senyega ga Boiketlo (0% Boiketlo): Go wela kwa go 0% go baka bothata jo bo jang Taele e le 1 kamoso. Go wela tlase ga seriti sa setlhopha go -2 go baka tlhaselo ya ditlhobolo.
tutorial.step4.desc: Ditshupanako tsa dikarolwana tse di kgolokwe di bala nako ya dikotsi tse di tlang (Tshekatsheko ya Brigadier Mokoena, Ntho ya ga Nandi, Ditlhopha tsa Polao tsa Izinkabi) mme di sala morago diphitlhelelo tsa gago tsa forensiki (Audit ya Docket #409, Go Roba Mogala, Khonboi ya Berth 14). Fa ditshupanako tsa dipatlisiso di tlala, dikgotlhang tsa makgaolakgang tsa bofelo di a bulega.
tutorial.step4.title: Kgato 4: Ditshupanako tsa Kotsi & Dipatlisiso
tutorial.step4.zone: Diwatšhe tsa Matshosetsi, Boiketlo le Bokamoso jwa Moanelwa
tutorial.step5.badge: KGATO YA 5 MO GO 6 // GODIMO GA HUD LE MMEPE
tutorial.step5.bullet1: Go Tswalwa ga Kgato 6: Di-server tsa City Hall le Golden Dragon di a tima ka nako ya Kgato 6—ntle le fa o duela R300 ya diesel.
tutorial.step5.bullet2: Bonase ya Tshireletso ya Kgato 6: Go tsena Pier 2 Cold Storage go bona Bonase ya +2 ka nako ya Kgato 6 ka ntlha ya go tima ga dipone tsa boemakepe.
tutorial.step5.bullet3: Dikgoreletsi tsa SAPS: Fa Mogote o fitlha go 4+, ditsela tsa toropo di a tswalwa, di ja R200 kgotsa Taele e le 1 go kgabaganya ntle le fa o na le SAPS Radio Scanner.
tutorial.step5.desc: Kelo e e kwa godimo ya Precinct Heat kgotsa Tshitshinyo e tsosa ditsela tsa dithibelatsela tse di tlhometsweng tsa SAPS magareng ga dikarolo. Go di kgabaganya go lopa Taele e le 1 kgotsa tjotjo ya R200 ya 'cold drink' ntle le fa o na le senaere e e kopolotsweng ya SAPS. Bona botumo jo bo siameng jwa Makgotlana go bulela bokgoni jwa togamaano jwa gangwe ka letsatsi jaaka Taolo ya Grid le Ditshereletso tsa Mabone a Mapududu (Blue-Light Escorts).
tutorial.step5.title: Kgato ya 5: Dithibelatsela le Ditshiamelo tsa Makgotlana
tutorial.step5.zone: Kgaolo ya Motlakase le Dikgoreletsi tsa Sepodisi (SAPS)
tutorial.step6.badge: KGATO YA 6 MO GO 6 // LETSHOLO LE GO TSHAMEKA GAPE
tutorial.step6.bullet1: Go Fena Tiro 1 le go Tsena mo Tirong 2: Bona dintlha di le 2 tsa botlhokwa go simolola Berth 14 Finale, mme o tobetse "Tswelela go Tiro 2: The Bluff Refinery →".
tutorial.step6.bullet2: Go Fena Tiro 2: Sekaseka lenaane la dipeipi tsa Island View le tshekatsheko ya petrochemical go simolola Katlholo ya Palamente.
tutorial.step6.bullet3: Tshameko e Ntšha+ le Rejisetara ya Fixer: Morago ga phenyo, leba Maemo a gago a Fixer mo Rejisetareng ya eThekwini, kokoanya Dibetšhe di le 6, mme o simolole Tshameko e Ntšha+ go boloka didirisiwa tsotlhe + R1,000!
tutorial.step6.desc: Bua le baferefere ba mo gae le baeteledipele ba makgotlana mo nodeng nngwe le nngwe go botsolotsa dintlha, go tlhagisa dibontshwa tsa forensiki, le go kopa ditshiamelo tsa gangwe fela. Tobetsa 'B' kgotsa tlanya 'BOARD' ka nako nngwe le nngwe go hlahloba boto ya gago ya thale e khibidu ya maano a bokhukhapa, o latedisa mohlala wa madi go tswa City Hall go ya Berth 14.

tutorial.step6.zone: Tiro 1 → Tiro 2, Polokelo ya Diphelo le Tshameko e Ntšha+
